titlePlain: Case Study: Responding to a Failed
subtitle: Lesson 31 · Capstone: Hardening a Mixed Environment

eyebrow: The report lands with three findings

steps.label: Finding 1
steps.sub: several Windows and Linux servers over 90 days behind on patches

steps.label: Finding 2
steps.sub: a domain-wide GPO grants local admin rights too broadly

steps.label: Finding 3
steps.sub: lnx-db-01 still allows root SSH login with password auth

code:
# Windows
Get-WindowsUpdate -Install -AcceptAll

# Linux — check first
apt list --upgradable
dnf check-update
caption: CVSS score decides the order — critical, internet-facing jumps the queue first.

code:
Get-GPOReport -Name "Domain-Wide-LocalAdmin" -ReportType Html -Path C:\Reports\gpo-audit.html

# Finding 3 — /etc/ssh/sshd_config
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
caption: Local admin membership gets narrowed back; root SSH login gets closed — after the logs are checked.

steps.label: Re-scan every patched server
steps.sub: documented proof, not just "we patched it"

steps.label: Re-verify the GPO
steps.sub: gpresult /r on a sample of affected machines

steps.label: Check the exposure window
steps.sub: search auth logs before treating finding 3 as closed
